title: reprosyn
summary: A privacy/synthetic-data generation research tool (a personal fork of the 'reprosyn' project) whose GAN-based synthesizer module wraps a forked CTGAN implementation to fit and sample synthetic tabular data, calling CTGANSynthesizer.fit() and .sample() directly from the ctgan package.
evidence: gans.py:112-115: self.ctgan = CTGANSynthesizer(**self.params); self.ctgan.fit(self.dataset.data, self.meta); self.output = self.ctgan.sample(self.size)
needs: No README present; repository appears to be a personal fork/modification of the 'reprosyn' synthetic data tool, and the ctgan dependency is a Turing Institute fork rather than the canonical ctgan package, so exact provenance is unverified.
